title: HudHpMpXpInjectionChain - the HUD HP/MP/XP globals have exactly one runtime writer family (the inbound frame chain), the XP-max field 0x7DA119 has NO writer at all, and the pump default msgid 0x1F is the only per-frame HP/MP path
objective: Prove which runtime code can change the HUD bar values. Enumerate every writer of the live HP/MP globals [0x35A34C]/[0x35A34A]/[0x35A34E] (0x7D9264/0x7D9262/0x7D9266) and the display block 0x7DA108..0x7DA11F, show the exact injection chain (frame parser -> queue -> pump -> handler -> display block -> live globals -> HUD formatter), and record that XP-max (0x7DA119) has no writer in this build.
question: What runtime paths write the HUD HP/MP/XP values? Are there any writers outside the server-frame chain? Which fields can never change?
method: Full-file static scans of Mir3.exe raw bytes for every write encoding to the target absolute addresses (89 /r modrm all registers both disp forms, 8B mov-to-mem forms, C7 imm32, 66 89 word, C6 imm8, A3/A1 eax forms, lea), plus disassembly of each hit; cross-reference with the pump default handler 0x4227F0 and self-stats handler 0x423000; HUD formatter setrect sites 0x4276D6/0x4276F0/0x42770D from earlier rounds.

hud_globals.live_hp_mp: [0x35A34C] = 0x7D9264 HP cur, [0x35A34A] = 0x7D9262 HP max, [0x35A34E] = 0x7D9266 MP cur (screen object 0x47EF18 + 0x35A34x)
hud_globals.display_block: [screen+0x35B1F0..] 97-byte decoded self block: +0x35B1F5 HP cur word, +0x35B1F7 MP cur word, +0x35B1F9 HP max word (level 0x7DA108, weight cur 0x7DA109, HP cur 0x7DA10D, MP cur 0x7DA10F, HP max 0x7DA111, MP max 0x7DA113, XP cur 0x7DA115, XP max 0x7DA119, weight max 0x7DA11F)

writer_enumeration.method_note: exhaustive scan over all encodings (89/8B modrm with every base register and disp32 form, absolute 89 05/0D/15/1D/25/2D/35/3D, C7 05 imm32, 66 89 word, C6 imm8, A3 eax-absolute, lea-targets) returned ZERO hits outside the frame chain
writer_enumeration.live_hp_cur_0x7D9264: writers: 0x423040 (msgid 0x34 self-stats, word [0x35B1F5] -> [0x35A34C]) and pump default 0x4229E4-family (msgid 0x1F, word[item+6] -> [0x35B1F5] + [0x35A34C]); also 0x4229EB/0x4229F2 in the same default branch
writer_enumeration.xp_max_0x7DA119: NO WRITER in the entire binary (all encodings scanned) - XP-max can never change at runtime in this build; the HUD exp bar formatter (0x2770D region) always divides by the compile-time/zero value
writer_enumeration.xp_cur_0x7DA115: written only via the msgid 0x34 97-byte block decode (0x452810 @0x423026 into [0x35B1F0]) - i.e. only by a full self-stats message
writer_enumeration.verdict: F308 CLOSED: the HUD HP/MP values have exactly two injection paths, both inside the inbound frame chain: msgid 0x1F (per-frame HP cur/max pair via pump default) and msgid 0x34 (full self-stats, HP+MP+XP block). No local/UI writer exists; XP-max is a never-written field.

injection_chain.0x1F_path: frame parser 0x41E6D0 -> jump table idx0 -> queue push 0x421CFC (item {+4 msgid 0x1F, +6 HP cur word, +8 HP max word}) -> pump 0x4227F0 -> default branch (own-id 0x77769C + msgid 0x1F): [0x35B1F5]=word[item+6], [0x35B1F9]=word[item+8], [0x35A34C]=word[item+6], [0x35A34A]=word[item+8]; cur==0 -> death 0x40A1E0 + 0x4561B0
injection_chain.0x34_path: frame parser -> queue -> pump -> 0x423000: id -> [0x35B1E8], byte -> [0x35B1E4], 97-byte base64 payload -> [0x35B1F0] block via 0x452810, then live sync [0x35A34C]/[0x35A34A]/[0x35A34E] from decoded words
injection_chain.hud_render: HUD bars: GameInter.wil frame 60 HP (rect 61,496,104,566), 61 MP (105,496,147,566), 63 EXP (61,586,400,597); SetRect sites 0x4276D6/0x4276F0/0x42770D; (血量)%d/%d / (魔法)%d/%d / (经验)%d/%d formatters read the display block
injection_chain.state_gate: FD_READ callback only buffers when [0x8B1878] (socket state byte) == 3 (in-game); the frame chain is the ONLY runtime writer of the HUD stat globals

conclusions: Live HP cur/max and MP cur writers = exactly the two frame-chain handlers (pump default 0x1F, self-stats 0x34); exhaustive encoding scan found no other write sites.
XP-max 0x7DA119 has no writer in the binary - statically immutable.
XP-cur 0x7DA115 is only reachable through the 97-byte self-stats block (msgid 0x34).
The HUD bars therefore reflect server state exclusively; there is no client-side stat mutation path.

closed_notes.F278_family_continuity: the pump default 0x1F HP path was partially described in earlier rounds as 'HP/MP update'; this finding pins the exact item offsets (+6 cur, +8 max) and the display-block mirror writes.

pending: Whether the XP-max field is populated by an older/newer server build or another frame type - strictly server-side concern for the build under study
The exact byte offsets inside the 97-byte self-stats payload for fields beyond HP/MP (level, weight, XP) - the block is decoded as a whole; field-level offsets for the remaining fields are candidate
